general_information.Description: The course provided student with knowledge about major machine learning paradigms (supervised & unsupervised), problems (classification, clustering, ...), and important machine learning tools (MaxEnt, SVM, ANN - DNN, HMM, CRF, ...)
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Using the Machine Learning methods learned, code a program that can solve Machine Learning problems (e.g. Classification, Clustering, …) possibly using language like Python, C, C++, Java
assessments.Grading Guide: Teacher will give the problem, students submit their code individually, the code and its output will be graded by teacher
